### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 3 |
| **Summary** | No journal-specific AI policy page found for BRAT; the applicable policy is Elsevier's publisher-wide generative-AI policy (applies to all Elsevier/ScienceDirect journals including this one). Facts: AI tools may be used for tasks like improving readability, literature synthesis; basic grammar/spell-check tools need no disclosure. A mandatory disclosure statement ('Declaration of Generative AI and AI-assisted technologies in the writing process') must be placed above the references when AI beyond basic checking is used. Prohibited: crediting AI as author/co-author, using raw AI output directly as manuscript text, AI-generated/altered images (except within research methodology itself), uploading copyrighted/unpublished content to external AI tools without confirming data-privacy terms. Reviewers are separately barred from uploading manuscripts to generative AI tools. Because this is publisher-level (not confirmed journal-specific), confidence is capped. |
| **Source URL** | https://www.elsevier.com/about/policies-and-standards/the-use-of-generative-ai-and-ai-assisted-technologies-in-writing-for-elsevier |

### Preprint Policy

> AI-research note (not broken down per-stage): Yes — Elsevier's standard sharing policy applies: preprints (e.g. on a preprint server) do not count as prior publication and do not jeopardize consideration for BRAT. This is the general Elsevier policy language surfaced via search of the ScienceDirect guide-for-authors page; the journal-specific guide-for-authors page itself returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch, so this is inferred from Elsevier's standard cross-journal preprint stance rather than a BRAT-specific confirmation.
> Source: https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/behaviour-research-and-therapy/publish/guide-for-authors

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **peer_review.type**: Journal-specific guide-for-authors page (sciencedirect.com/.../publish/guide-for-authors) returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch and search snippets did not state single- vs double-blind explicitly for this journal; left null rather than assuming the Elsevier default.
- **positioning.accepts_now**: Could not fetch the ScienceDirect journal homepage (403 Forbidden) to pull actual 2024-2026 article titles or a confirmed current special-issue CFP list; only the general aims-and-scope description was recoverable via search snippets.
- **positioning.framing_required**: No CFP or editorial framing guidance was found beyond the standard aims and scope; not enough to state a required framing without inventing one.
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: SciRev page explicitly shows 'n/a' for immediate-rejection rate and % accepted last year (dataset too sparse, only 2 total reviews).
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No forum discussion (muchong/zhihu/fabiaoji/reddit) surfaced any concrete first-hand account of reviewer culture for this specific journal; the single SciRev complaint about editor disengagement is anecdotal (n=1) and not generalized into a 'culture' claim.
